_comment: The one list of workspace distributions (packages/<name>). Release, sync and distribution tooling read only this file: adding a package is one entry here plus packages/<name>/ itself. Order is release order. kind: kernel (the one version source), root (composition root), module (sandloom.modules entry point `module` = import name), driver (sandloom.drivers entry points in `drivers`). standard: installed by sandloom[standard]. tag_release: a <name>-v<version> tag push may release it (true only where the pypi environment allows that tag; the plan job refuses any other tag before validation). console: the distribution ships a web console served from its import package.
